intervention_names.frozen: freeze expected counts and their decay at initial zero counts, hence uniform attempted law
intervention_names.no_planning: continue prediction learning but use uniform-law occupancy forecasts in the identical planner; not prediction-free planning
intervention_names.predictive: learned attempted law used for occupancy forecasts/planning

matched_prediction_interpretation: Identical experience only for pairs whose full trajectory and map/action checks pass; episode sums/counts retained
